title: 第23章 铁皮人第24章 血色牧场
lines: 格林一行人已经出发了，而格林的家也正在扩建，资金由古兹出，毕竟当初可是给了古兹整整3成的分红。
而蜜语坊的收入在格林的经营下相当可观，并且在格林做出选择之前，三大商会都会对格林进行示好，会不断帮助格林。
当然，也有时会尝试给格林下点套路，不过在格林避开后，三大商会也就规矩一点了。
如今，蜜语坊的业务范围已经从甜品推广到了其他餐饮行业，很多格林想吃的、相当多食物都搞了出来。
格林制作的食物对于当地的饮食简直是降维打击，全新的菜系让这个世界的人大为震撼。
听说有皇室的人也喜欢，也不知道是不是真的。
总之，古兹拥有足够的资金来扩建家，格林用起古兹的钱也是毫不手软，在附近买了几块地后，设计了一份大别墅图纸丢给别人后，就准备开建了。
在确定工人了解了图纸后，格林带着古兹和露姆离开了，额，这个城镇叫什么来着，哦！
德尔克。
不得不说，格林脑海里的知识相当有用，虽然不知道哪里来的就是了。
“为什么我们一定要飞啊？”
古兹不满地说道，虽然飞可以更快一点，但是看着那个史莱姆抱着格林她就不爽。
露姆抬头看了一眼古兹：（???）
古兹：！
格林察觉到了风属性魔力的流动，急忙道：“古兹冷静一点，这么多次了，你应该知道露姆是故意气你的。
还有你，别整天惹古兹了，建房子的钱可是还有你的一份呢。
这件事回去之后你就可以给我打工了。”
露姆闻言立刻哭丧：。
“装可怜也没有用，回去之后就给我开始学习，然后工作。”
在确定格林真的不吃这套后，露姆直接嘟起了嘴：哼！
飞着飞着，格林认为古兹应该休息一下了，于是降落下来。
落地后，格林开始研究地图，别误会，格林的方向感其实很不错的只不过不擅长应付迷宫，这种赶路是不会出问题的。
“让我看看，我们现在大概在银月森林边缘，在往前走会路过一个村庄，懒得管它叫什么了。
你们累吗？累的话我们就去休息一下，不累直接赶去贝希摩斯牧场吧。”
叫是叫贝希摩斯，可是那里可没有贝希摩斯那种比蒙巨兽，牧场主取这个名字不知道是为什么。
作为被深渊蛊惑的怪物，天界对它可没有好感，这个牧场想来在之前也没有什么生意。
不对，根据调查显示，牧场荒废之前的经营状况似乎很好。
牧场之所以荒废，是因为牧场的主人——三个猪人中的两个因意外去世了，而仅剩的一个又不知所踪。
所以牧场就荒废了，而其他人又没有开发权之类的，也就不能再次开发了。
“我不累，蓝色史莱姆你呢？”
“哼哼～”
（完全没问题）
“既然这样，我们就直接过去吧。”
格林下了决定，“跑得快一点的话，应该可以在一个小时之内到。”
古兹有点奇怪，但是还没有来得及说出口就被格林抱住。
左手抱着露姆，右手抱着古兹，格林纯粹依靠肉身力量的跑步，甚至比古兹飞还快。
古兹一开始还惊呼了几句，但是后面又发现格林抱的相当平稳，而且很舒服，就是风有点大。
“格林，你怎么抱得这么熟练啊？”
格林听不到哦。
动用了风魔法，古兹再次提问。
这一次格林不得不回答了，“在地下城的时候，露姆一直缠在我的身上，抱着抱着就学会了这个方法了。”
content_en:
Green and his party have already set off, and Green's home is also being expanded. The funds are provided by Guzi. After all, Guzi was given a full 30% dividend in the first place.
The income of Miyufang is considerable under Green's management, and before Green makes his choice, the three major chambers of commerce will show their favor to Green and will continue to help him.
Of course, they would sometimes try to trick Greene, but after Greene avoided it, the three major chambers of commerce became more disciplined.
Nowadays, the business scope of Miyufang has been extended from desserts to other catering industries, and a lot of food that Green wants to eat has been produced.
The food produced by Green is simply a dimensionality-reducing blow to the local diet, and the brand-new cuisine shocked the people of this world.
I heard that some members of the royal family also like it, but I don’t know if that’s true.
In short, Guzi had enough funds to expand his home, and Green used Guzi's money without mercy. After buying a few pieces of land nearby, he designed a drawing of a large villa and gave it to others, and he was ready to start construction.
After making sure that the workers understood the drawings, Green took Guz and Lum and left. Um, what is the name of this town? Oh!
Delk.
It has to be said that the knowledge in Green's mind is quite useful, although he doesn't know where it came from.
…
"Why do we have to fly?"
Guz said dissatisfiedly that although she could fly faster, she was unhappy seeing the slime holding Green.
Lum raised his head and glanced at Guz: (???)
Guz:!
Green noticed the flow of wind magic and hurriedly said: "Calm down Guz, after so many times, you should know that Lum is deliberately angry with you.
And you, don't mess with Guzi all day long, you still have a share of the money to build the house.
You can work for me after returning from this matter. "
Lum cried immediately after hearing this:.
??︿??.
"It's no use pretending to be pitiful. When you get back, just start studying for me and then work."
After confirming that Green really didn't want to take this trick, Lum pouted: Humph!
(3′)
Flying, Green thought that Guz should take a rest, so he landed.
After landing, Green began to study the map. Don't get me wrong, Green's sense of direction is actually very good, but he is not good at dealing with mazes. This kind of rush will not cause problems.
"Let me see, we are probably at the edge of the Silver Moon Forest now, and we will pass a village as we go forward. I don't care what it is called.
Are you tired? If we are tired, we will take a rest. If not, we can go directly to Behemoth Ranch. "
It's called Behemoth, but there is no Behemoth like Behemoth there. The rancher doesn't know why he chose this name.
As a monster that was bewitched by the abyss, the heavenly world did not like it. It seems that this ranch had no business before.
No, according to the investigation, the ranch seemed to be operating in good condition before it was abandoned.
The reason why the pasture is abandoned is because the owners of the pasture, two of the three pigmen, died in accidents, and the only one left is missing.
Therefore, the pasture was abandoned, and other people did not have development rights, so they could not develop it again.
"I'm not tired, how about you Blue Slime?"
"Hmph~"
(No problem at all)
"In this case, let's go directly."
Green made up his mind, "If you run faster, you should be able to get there within an hour."
"Run?"
Guz was a little strange, but before he could say anything, he was hugged by Green.
Holding Lum in his left hand and Guz in his right hand, Green ran purely relying on physical strength, even faster than Guz.
Guz exclaimed a few words in surprise at first, but later found that Green's hug was quite stable and comfortable, but the wind was a bit strong.
"Green, how come you are so good at holding me?"
Green can't hear it.
Using wind magic, Guz asked again.
This time Green had no choice but to answer, "When we were in the dungeon, Lum kept clinging to me. I learned this method by holding him."
title_en: Chapter 23 The Tin Woodman Chapter 24 The Bloody Pasture
